caption: The drawing depicts a built-in wooden cupboard set into a wall corner. The cupboard consists of two main sections, each with two paneled doors. The upper section has two taller doors, each featuring two rectangular recessed panels, and the lower section has two shorter doors, each with one rectangular recessed panel. The cupboard is illustrated in shades of light brown and beige, with simple outlines marking the panels, hinges, and round knobs on each door. The surrounding wall is left mostly blank, with only a hint of cream-colored paint and minimal baseboard and chair rail detailing in brown. The composition centers the cupboard, and the artist’s signature “Geo. V. Vezolles” appears in the lower right corner.
title: Shaker Room Cupboard
